Wednesday World pb Bloomington Bicycles

Bloomington, IN · Road

Wednesday World pb Bloomington Bicycles is a road group ride in Bloomington, IN. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from E Kirkwood Ave & S Indiana Ave. About 31–47 miles, fast.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: fast. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday World pb Bloomington Bicycles group ride

Bloomington's fast Wednesday ride, with a rotation of five routes called out on the day. Little 500 riders and local strong riders show up. Not a beginner ride.
